banners.title: 🎉 CAtool is completely free during early access
banners.body: No card, no subscription — every tool is free while we grow. Fair paid plans may come later, with plenty of notice.

banners.title: NEW: GSTR-2B vs Books Recon is here
banners.body: Reconcile GSTR-2B against your books — load the portal JSON or Excel, import books straight from TallyPrime, and get a colour-coded Excel with Sec 16(4), Rule 37 and RCM checks. Install it from the Home tab.
